title: Team | Vika accounting, tax and audit partners

texts.text: Most companies do not need more numbers. They need the same numbers, earlier, and someone to say what they mean.
Trained with a Big Four firm in London, moved to Dubai in 2014 and opened Vika two years later. Leads client relationships and the studio.
A tax return should hold no surprises for you. If it does, we told you too late.
Twelve years in tax across the Gulf. Joined in 2023 to build the corporate tax practice and now signs off every return the firm files.
A good audit starts in the first month of the year, not the last week of it.
Leads the audit practice and its quality reviews in both offices. Fifteen years in audit, most of them with owner managed groups.
Who runs your file week to week.
Closing by the tenth is a habit, not a heroic effort. We make it boring on purpose.Leo BrandtACMAHead of AccountingLondon

One partner, one manager, one inbox.
Every return, set of accounts and audit opinion goes out under a named partner. You meet them in your first week, not at year end.
Your manager closes the books by the tenth working day and is the first person you message when something changes.
Questions are answered within one working day by someone who knows your file. There is no ticket queue and no call centre.
We hire twice a year, in January and July. Trainees welcome.

scripts.comment: GSAP / Navbar menu and Studio Statement / Office clocks tick: live analog clocks in the menu and on Studio Statement. Each clock row carries its time zone in a data-clock-tz attribute, such as Europe/London. GSAP turns the hour, minute and second hands and writes the time into the element marked data-clock-time (or .office-text_time). Remove this block to drop the clocks; the dials then show their resting position.

GSAP / Navbar menu / Link hover focus: pointing at or tabbing to one of the main menu links dims the others to 50% and turns that link to the accent colour, with a small nudge to the right. The accent is read from the menu's Accent Primary variable, so a new brand colour carries over. Remove this block to keep the links static.

GSAP / Global / Counters count up on scroll: figures count up from zero the first time they scroll into view, using GSAP and ScrollTrigger. It picks up the studio figures, the Statement ledger, case study results and metrics, and any element you give a data-count attribute. The text stays as typed in the Designer or the CMS, such as 2,100 or 9 days; the script counts the number inside it and keeps the words around it. Remove this block and the figures simply show as typed.
